$comment: Base colors for every tonal scale. Edit a hex here, then run `npm run colors`. Each base is placed at the step whose target lightness it is closest to, and kept exact. `pins` are other official values kept exact at their closest step. Source: Food Integrity Project Style Guide (draft for review), pages 5-9 and 18.

singles.name: birch
singles.label: Birch
singles.purpose: Default background for every brand, print and digital. Never substitute pure white.

singles.name: frost
singles.label: Frost
singles.purpose: Utility neutral: table stripes, form fields, disabled states, data panels, image wells. Never a page ground.

scales.name: stone
scales.label: Stone
scales.purpose: Interface neutral for borders, help text and disabled states. Frost is its 50 step.

scales.name: cacao
scales.label: Cacao
scales.purpose: The parent's one dark. Sets all type and inverted panels. Warm near-black from the logo.

scales.name: loam
scales.label: Loam
scales.purpose: Supporting tone. The brown of turned soil, a lighter tone of Cacao.

scales.name: milkweed
scales.label: Milkweed Leaf
scales.purpose: The parent's signature. Grey-green of the plant the monarch cannot breed without.

scales.name: forest
scales.label: Forest
scales.purpose: One dark for Non-GMO Project and the Collective. Sets all type and inverted panels.

scales.name: seafoam
scales.label: Seafoam
scales.purpose: Supporting tint. Fills panels and cards where Birch alone is too flat.

scales.name: monarch
scales.label: Monarch
scales.purpose: Non-GMO Project signature. One point of emphasis per view. Never small text.

scales.name: dark-matter
scales.label: Dark Matter
scales.purpose: Non-UPF Verified one dark. Keeps the program separate from Non-GMO Project at shelf distance.

scales.name: almond
scales.label: Almond
scales.purpose: Supporting tint. Does the warming work underneath Dragon Fruit.

scales.name: dragonfruit
scales.label: Dragon Fruit
scales.purpose: Non-UPF Verified signature and seal color. The mark, headlines and single emphasis elements.

scales.name: cornflower
scales.label: Corn Flower
scales.purpose: Collective supporting accent. Shapes, charts and panels. Never small text.

scales.name: romanesco
scales.label: Romanesco
scales.purpose: Collective signature. Shapes, charts and panels. Never small text.

scales.name: warning
scales.label: Warning
scales.purpose: Status: warning, needs attention, expiring soon.

scales.name: info
scales.label: Info
scales.purpose: Status: informational, in review, neutral notices.

$pairings: Text-on-background pairs listed in 02-color.md 'Approved text pairings'. Ratios are computed, never typed.
